[features]
default = []
# Panic on purpose from inside the scratchpad stack, to check that the panic
# report moves back to the RAM stack and prints.
panic-on-stack = []
# Put a handler of the example's own in the exception vector, chaining to
# psx-rt's, and declare it stack-safe.
chained-vector = []

psx-gpu  = { path = "../../crates/psx-gpu" }

[package]
name    = "hello-tri"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "GPL-2.0-or-later"

# Examples live outside the sdk/ workspace so cargo doesn't try to
# compile them for the host target when the user runs `cargo check`
# from the repo root.
[workspace]

[[bin]]
name = "hello-tri"
path = "src/main.rs"

[profile.release]
# No unwinder in no_std; abort on panic keeps the binary small and
# doesn't require `libunwind` bits.
panic = "abort"
codegen-units = 1
# Link-time optimisation shrinks the binary; optional, but handy
# when examples are the smoke test for the SDK.
lto = true

[dependencies]
psx-gpu = { path = "../../crates/psx-gpu" }
psx-rt  = { path = "../../crates/psx-rt" }
